caption:
You keep hoping it'll turn out different. But a harvest only ever answers the seed that actually went into the ground. (Galatians 6:7 devotional)

You dress up what you planted as if God grades the packaging, but He isn't fooled by appearances — He reads the seed, not the story around it. A harvest always comes back the same kind as what went into the ground, so sowing to the Spirit is how an already-received salvation bears its own fruit, never a way to earn it. And here's the grace: the seed Christ planted in you is already good, so today just drop one small seed for the Spirit and let it grow true to kind.
